item.title: Habit Tracker Spreadsheet: The Never Miss Twice Rule (Don't Quit After One Miss)
item.description: The never miss twice rule: missing once happens to everyone, so the goal is simply not to miss two days in a row. The Never Miss Twice habit tracker makes it easy with a 2-minute version of each habit, a 12-month tracker and a printable recovery card for the day after a miss. Save this quote and tap to get the tracker.
